description: CASEWORK C1 (casework.md; loft.cabinets 1.0.0): one frameless B24 in 3/4 plywood, one drawer over one door, one adjustable shelf, on a 4.5 in toe kick set back 3: 15 panels, 3 526.66796875 in^3, 282.4375 in (23.54 ft) of banding, 2 hinges and a pair of 22 in slides. model.json is the plugin's expansion with the member materials documents applies; members.json each body's member metadata (packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_cabinets.py pins both).
derivation: Every expectation is ANALYTIC, from services/geometry/tests/test_casework.py's independent script of casework.md's conventions (spec(), C1 typed from its table), never from the plugin: each panel a box, a notched side its box less its 3 x 4.5 toe notch; summed in exact rational arithmetic (x 25.4 = mm exactly).
volume = 3/4 x 4 317.890625 in^2 + 1/2 x 340 + 1/4 x 473 = 3 526.66796875 in^3 (casework.md C1's areas; the sides 24 x 34.5 less the 3 x 4.5 notch).
surface_area = each panel's box area, a notched side's less twice its notch's face; bodies are separate.
topology: a box 6 faces, 12 edges, 1 shell; a notched side 8 faces, 18 edges. MESH: a box 24 vertices and 12 triangles, a notched side 36 and 20 (two hexagons of 4 triangles, six quads of 2).
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), 2026-10-23: the kernel's volume is 2.2e-8 mm^3 off the exact 5.78e7 mm^3 sum over 15 separate bodies (its summation round-off), centroid 1.1e-13 mm, mass 7.3e-12 g. 1e-7 is 4.5x the worst; a panel 0.001 in out of place moves the volume by >= 0.3 mm^3.
